score_explanation.slope: Inverse slope — flatter terrain scores higher. Steep slopes impede excavation.
score_explanation.depression: Natural terrain sink depth — deeper depressions score higher (natural storage).
score_explanation.catchment: Flow accumulation proxy — more upstream cells → more potential runoff contribution.
score_explanation.elevation: Relative lowness within ROI — lower areas are natural collection points.
score_explanation.rainfall: Annual rainfall — higher rainfall → more potential runoff to fill the pond.

suitability.methodology_note: Candidate sites identified using terrain-derived suitability scoring on the DEM. Slope, depression depth, flow accumulation, elevation, and rainfall are combined as a weighted composite. Results are planning estimates requiring field verification.
